units: <cite ref="Sukkah 39b:4">Succ. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>בכדי מן</he> for as much only as is needed for the day.
Ib. דהאי מ׳ וכ׳ that man means support, v. preced.—Esp. מַנָּא the manna.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 16:27">Targ. Y. ib. 27</cite>; a. e. (some ed. <cite ref="M00048"><he>מָנָא</he></cite>).
